import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Fetch all in one operation
url = 'https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=all:%22multimodal+RAG%22+OR+all:%22multimodal+retrieval-augmented%22&start=0&max_results=5&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
res = web_fetch(url, max_chars=20000)

# Parse immediately
root = ET.fromstring(res['content'])
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}
entries = root.findall('atom:entry', ns)

papers = []
for entry in entries:
    title = entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip().replace('\n', ' ')
    paper_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text.split('/abs/')[-1]
    summary = entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip().replace('\n', ' ')
    published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
    authors = [a.find('atom:name', ns).text for a in entry.findall('atom:author', ns)]
    papers.append({'title': title, 'arxiv_id': paper_id, 'summary': summary, 'published': published, 'authors': authors})

# Print what we got
print(f"Found {len(papers)} papers")
for i, p in enumerate(papers):
    print(f"\n[{i+1}] {p['title']}")
    print(f"    ID: {p['arxiv_id']}")
    print(f"    Date: {p['published'][:10]}")
    print(f"    Authors: {', '.join(p['authors'][:5])}")
    print(f"    Summary: {p['summary'][:300]}")
    print("---")

# Store for later use in this session
import json
with open('papers_data.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(papers, f, indent=2)
print("\nSaved papers data to papers_data.json")
